name: What types of cabinet hardware can I replace?

mainEntity.name: What types of cabinet hardware can I replace?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can replace most types of cabinet hardware, including hinges, pulls, knobs, and drawer slides. Hinges come in various styles like concealed, surface-mount, and specialty options. Pulls and knobs offer a wide range of aesthetic choices, from contemporary to traditional. Drawer slides can be side-mount, under-mount, or center-mount, impacting drawer function and capacity. The selection depends on your cabinet style, desired functionality, and aesthetic preferences. Replacing hardware is a cost-effective way to update your kitchen or bathroom cabinets without a full renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can replace hinges, pulls, knobs, and drawer slides. The type depends on your cabinet style and desired functionality.
